name: 710 Labs Joint | Cherry Zest #4
description: Cherry Zest #4 is full of sweet berries, sour lemon and nutty grapes, all wrapped up with a touch of creaminess. As soon as the strain hits, it envelopes you in a feeling of euphoria. After about two hours of pleasantly soaring in the clouds, your mind settles down and relaxes into a leisurely state of utter bliss.
